messages:
Evelyn Park: sharing a quick mock — moved the stream controls inline into the prompt drawer (left of the composer). Control is now Pause / Resume + Regen. trying to save vertical space in the chat pane. reactions?
Diego Morales: interesting. inline could help for narrow screens. worried about accidental pauses when users browse prompts. do we need a compact confirmation for mobile? :iphone:
Riley Carter: UX thought: use a toggle affordance for Pause/Resume instead of two separate buttons. single icon that flips state reduces clutter. show tooltip: 'Pause streaming (Space)'.
Nina Gupta: accessibility flag: tooltips aren't enough. make sure the control is reachable by tab order in the drawer and has both aria-pressed="true" and aria-label states, e.g., aria-pressed="true" when paused.
Ava Kim: copy nit: "Pause" vs "Hold" — which is clearer to users? "Pause" is standard but "Hold" might imply saving a draft. prefer "Pause". also regen microcopy: "Regenerate" > "Try again" for clarity.
Evelyn Park: agreed on Pause. also prototyping a sticky mini-token counter in the same drawer header: small pill that counts tokens in-flight and final total when done. concern: will this distract or be useful?
Diego Morales: good for power users. ops asks we approximate tokens to nearest 10 during streaming to reduce update frequency. show exact number only on completion.
Riley Carter: animation thought: token pill pulses while streaming. but add prefers-reduced-motion support. if reduced-motion enabled, switch to subtle color change only.
Nina Gupta: screen reader behavior: token pill should have aria-hidden=true during streaming and then an sr-only announcement after completion: 'Response generated: 240 tokens'. don't announce intermediate numbers.
Ava Kim: prompt library integration: show an inline cost indicator under prompts: small text 'approx. 30 tok' plus a tooltip with cost tiers (free, paid) and potential latency. copy: 'Est. tokens • ~30'. keep abbreviations consistent.
Evelyn Park: product question — show cost to everyone or opt-in? privacy/cost concerns from legal?
Diego Morales: default to show for trial/free users. enterprise can hide via org setting. annotate the setting in the mock.
Riley Carter: implementation detail: Pause must not drop the KV cache. pausing should halt stream frames but keep cache and context intact so Resume continues seamlessly.
Nina Gupta: keyboard shortcuts: Space to Pause/Resume when focus in composer, Shift+Space to step a single chunk (useful for review). need to document and expose in help.
Ava Kim: microcopy tweak for regen-on-pause: if user clicks Regenerate while paused, we should clarify behavior: 'Resume and regenerate' vs 'Restart and regenerate'. prefer 'Restart and regenerate' to avoid confusion.
Evelyn Park: good point — I'll show a small confirmation inline: 'Regenerate will restart the response.' ephemeral toast.
Diego Morales: telemetry: batch token updates and user actions every 10s. also emit pause/resume events for analytics.
Riley Carter: front-end: we'll debounce UI regen button by 400ms to avoid double requests. also show an ephemeral spinner in the drawer icon when queued.
Nina Gupta: accessibility testing: I'll run Narrator + JAWS on the prototype. ensure focus order: prompt selection -> drawer controls -> composer.
ConsoleBot: mock-up link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/playground-inline-controls updated by Evelyn Park at 1769012500.
Evelyn Park: thanks everyone — will iterate on the figma with these changes and drop a short video of interactions. ping if anything else pops up. :sparkles:
